name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies is a seasoned IT Systems Manager with over 25 years of experience, the last 12 dedicated to the high-pressure environment of motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Alistair transitioned from a successful career in corporate IT after attending a track day with a friend. He was immediately hooked and saw an opportunity to apply his skills in a field he was passionate about.

Alistair's approach to managing Oregon Team's IT infrastructure is characterized by meticulous planning and a focus on reliability. He understands the critical importance of seamless data flow and communication during races and testing. Alistair is not one for flashy solutions; he prioritizes proven technologies and robust systems that can withstand the rigors of a demanding schedule.

What sets Alistair apart is his ability to anticipate potential issues before they arise. He's a master of preventative maintenance and proactive troubleshooting, ensuring that the team's IT systems are always running at peak performance. His calm demeanor and unflappable nature make him a valuable asset during stressful race weekends.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, preferring handwritten notes to digital devices for important tasks.
Insists on a specific brand of Earl Grey tea, brewed precisely at 95 degrees Celsius.
Has a habit of muttering technical jargon under his breath when concentrating.
